articles.title: Lasso (apply area)
articles.summary: Draw a free-hand outline; the zone only affects what is inside. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > ZONE POPOUT PANEL (click a zone card in the left column; Shift+E shows / hides the panel) > APPLY AREA. Range see SCHEMA: part names come from get_car_map; band 0-1 fractions (height = roof-line to rocker, length = front to rear); rect/cells only for details under ~12% of the sheet, starts at none = 'nothing selected yet'.
when: The area to restrict is not a rectangle.

controls.label: Lasso (apply area)
controls.range: see SCHEMA: part names come from get_car_map; band 0-1 fractions (height = roof-line to rocker, length = front to rear); rect/cells only for details under ~12% of the sheet
controls.effect: Draw a free-hand outline; the zone only affects what is inside

pitfalls: Close the shape by returning near the start point.

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: Chooses which pixels the zone owns: a named part (hood, left side), a stripe band, the numbers / sponsors / stripes the app found, a layer, or everything / the rest. Applies to: Where the zone paints.

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: It runs over see SCHEMA: part names come from get_car_map; band 0-1 fractions (height = roof-line to rocker, length = front to rear); rect/cells only for details under ~12% of the sheet and starts at none = 'nothing selected yet'. Measured in selection.

deep.heading: How it combines with other controls
deep.body: remaining:true = whatever other zones did not claim (keep it last); everything+paintable = whole-car base. exclude:['numbers','sponsors'] keeps decals out. Boxes over ~12% of the sheet are refused.

protips: Typical values: Whole-car look = everything+paintable; a stripe = band; 'only the hood' = part. Put detail zones above the body zone.

faq.a: Draw a free-hand outline; the zone only affects what is inside.

articles.title: Zone eye / duplicate / link / x icons on...
articles.summary: Eye hides a zone for testing, the copy icon duplicates, the x deletes it. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > left column > zone card. Range true|false, starts at False.
when: Temporarily see the car without a zone; copy a zone to reuse its look.

controls.label: Zone eye / duplicate / link / x icons on...
controls.effect: Eye hides a zone for testing, the copy icon duplicates, the x deletes it

pitfalls: x removes the zone (undoable with Ctrl+Z).
aliases: zone eye duplicate link x icons on

deep.heading: What it changes
deep.body: Temporarily removes the zone from the render (the car shows what is under it). Applies to: Whole zone.

deep.heading: Under the hood
deep.body: Behind the scenes it sets the zone muted. It runs over true|false and starts at False. Measured in bool.

deep.heading: How it combines with other controls
deep.body: A muted zone does not claim pixels, so zones below it take them.

protips: Typical values: 'try without the stripes' -> mute instead of delete (reversible).

faq.q: What does Zone eye / duplicate / link / x icons on... do?
faq.a: Eye hides a zone for testing, the copy icon duplicates, the x deletes it.

faq.q: What is the range and starting value of Zone eye / duplicate / link / x icons on...?
faq.a: Range true|false. It starts at False.

faq.q: Why does Zone eye / duplicate / link / x icons on... not seem to do what I expect?
faq.a: x removes the zone (undoable with Ctrl+Z).
